published.source: the DPS report's main run of this request after the November 19 hotfix (Two-Handed Weapon Specialization on all Holy damage) and its Holy Strike line (wowsimcli, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s)

verify.note: the report main run of this request (2026-11-22), 180 ± 20 s, 20,000 iterations, seed 1

summary: Ret sub-Holy with Exorcism, for an Undead or Demon boss.
advantage: Exorcism only works on Undead and Demons. Purifying Power 2 makes its cooldown a third shorter.
advantageShort: Exorcism only hits Undead and Demons. Purifying Power 2 makes its cooldown a third shorter.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Consecration
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Righteousness whenever no damage seal is up

Unsealed Wrath: with Seal of Righteousness up, once it has stored 2 copies, Seal of Command, so the next swing spends them all (one Righteousness hit each) and stores a Command copy. Back to Seal of Righteousness once Command has stored all 3, keeping the mana for Exorcism
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.
Unsealed Wrath is new with the October 30 hotfix and unverified: the sim lets landed white swings store and spend the copies, and rolls each stored Seal of Command at its own 7 a minute.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage as well as physical, and Vengeance stacks up to 5 times, as the November 2 development notes announce. Client 1.60.1.70753 still has Physical only and 3 stacks; the sim takes the notes' values until a hotfix or client build says otherwise (standards 37).
No Holy Wrath. Its 2s cast resets the swing.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60_sub_holy except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human (follows its base build, paladin__level_60_sub_holy). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Talents, rotation and its notes re-searched on 2026-11-01 for the launch realms' October 30 hotfix trees (1.60.1.70707+hf); the request is the earlier one with the new talentsString and rotation (tools/rotopt/paladin_presets.sh). 2026-11-15 (Judgement of Command melee again, rolling Windfury Totem and on-hit procs): rotation re-searched with tools/rotopt over 120 / 180 / 300 sec, kept only where it won all six cells (seeds 1 and 1000003, 20,000 iterations); see tools/rotopt/paladin_presets.sh. Swap to Seal of Command on 2 Righteousness copies (was 3): +1.6 / +1.0 / +1.4 (seed 1), +1.2 / +1.2 / +1.3 (seed 1000003). The published and verify numbers predate it. Re-checked after Two-Handed Weapon Specialization was ruled to reach the seals, Holy Strike, Judgement of Command and Consecration: the same pick wins +2.6 / +1.9 / +2.2 (seed 1), +2.1 / +2.1 / +2.1 (seed 1000003). 2026-11-22 (Blizzard's November 19 hotfix: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage, +1.15% here): rotation knobs re-searched (29 candidates: copies, twist window, mana rules, seal, Consecration, Hammer of Wrath, Exorcism and Holy Wrath placement and floors), kept only where it won all six cells (seeds 1 and 1000003, 120 / 180 / 300 sec, 20,000 iterations). Holy Strike ahead of the seal and twist lines (holyStrikeFirst=1): +0.4 / +0.6 / +0.2 (seed 1), +0.4 / +0.6 / +0.4 (seed 1000003). The published and verify numbers predate it.
